literal: By deceit wealth having accumulated feeling secure [is] unbaked clay inside vessel water having poured having kept like.
translation: Feeling secure after accumulating wealth by deceitful means is like pouring and storing water in a vessel of unbaked clay.
modern: வஞ்சனையான வழிகளில் பொருளைச் சேர்த்து வைத்துப் பாதுகாப்பாக உணர்வது, சுடப்படாத பச்சை மண்ணால் செய்த பானையில் நீரை ஊற்றி வைப்பதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet warns against accumulating wealth through unethical or deceitful means. The word 'சலம்' refers to deceit or falseness. The poet compares such ill-gotten wealth to water poured into a vessel made of unbaked clay ('பசுமண் கலம்'). Just as the unbaked clay will dissolve and both the vessel and the water will be lost, wealth gained by deceit will inevitably destroy itself and its possessor.
